study_identification_part.si_4_title: Molecular and micro-architectural mapping of gray matter alterations in psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used 8 datasets for psychosis-related and healthy control samples: ABCD (Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development), ALSPAC (Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children), ASRB (Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank), B-SNIP (Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes), CNP/LA5c (UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics), MCIC (Mental Illness and Neuroscience Discovery Institute Clinical Imaging Consortium), PAFIP (Programa de Atencion a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis), and UK Biobank. Additionally, the normative model was pre-trained using lifespan brain charts from Bethlehem et al. (2022) which included ~120,000 participants from 100 different studies.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "MRI from individuals with chronic schizophrenia (SCZ; n = 525; age = 37.63 +/- 12.06) and schizoaffective disorder (SAD; n = 62; age = 33.77 +/- 10.78)... were obtained from Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD), Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB), Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes (B-SNIP), UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP) LA5c Study, Mental Illness and Neuroscience Discovery (MIND) Institute Clinical Imaging Consortium (MCIC), and UK Biobank (UKB)"; "MRI data from individuals who were determined to have experienced a first episode of psychosis (FEP; n = 352)... were obtained from Programa de Atencion a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis (PAFIP)"; "Individuals who were suspected of having had psychotic experiences (PEs)... were sourced from Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC)"; "This model... estimated cross-sectional normative age-related trends from 100 different studies (around 120,000 participants)"
